name: Flower Garden Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Garden Solitaire is a card game based on beautiful flowers. If you are a fan of flowers and solitaire, then you will love the aesthetics of this online game. Each game session is set against a lovely garden-based background. Some of the cards are also decorated with flowers that you can enjoy while you play. While this is a casual game, each session is timed. Complete the game before you run out of time and have to start over. If you think the game cannot be won, you can also restart the game. Each restart gives you a different combination of cards. From the menu, select High Scores to see if your best score lands you on the top 200 players. Play another round of solitaire to increase your score or just to unwind.
